2607.21156.title: SafeStep: AI-powered Travel Assistance for Elderly People with Frailty or Dementia
2607.21156.paper_summary: More than a million people in the UK suffer from frailty or dementia, which severely compromise their ability to travel in urban environments. This paper presents SafeStep, an AI-driven travel system that assists elderly users with their journeys. At the core of SafeStep is a novel travel graph representation, which integrates route planning with predictive modelling. For each stage of a journey, the system (i) generates personalized failure scenarios using a combi-nation of LLMs and the Anticip8 behavioral prediction engine, (ii) proposes targeted interventions, and (iii) estimates the impact of interventions on out-come probabilities. This enables SafeStep to select interventions that maximize the likelihood of the person reaching their destination. SafeStep was evaluated through experiments on travel graph generation and a field study involving 26 real-world journeys. Results showed that combining Anticip8 for failure pre-diction with GPT-based models for intervention evaluation yields the most re-liable performance. User feedback indicated that SafeStep improves confidence and perceived safety during travel, although interface usability needs to be im-proved for the target demographic. In the future, we would like to improve and release SafeStep. The AI system that was developed for SafeStep could be ap-plied in other areas, such as mental health, career coaching and addiction treatment.
2607.21156.paper_summary_zh: 英國有超過一百萬人受到虛弱或癡呆症的困擾，這嚴重影響了他們在城市環境中旅行的能力。這篇論文介紹了SafeStep，一個由人工智慧驅動的旅行系統，旨在協助老年用戶進行旅行。SafeStep的核心是一種新穎的旅行圖表示法，它將路徑規劃與預測建模相結合。在旅行的每個階段，系統 (i) 使用LLMs和Anticip8行為預測引擎的組合生成個性化的失敗場景，(ii) 提出針對性的干預措施，並 (iii) 估算干預措施對結果概率的影響。這使得SafeStep能夠選擇最大化個人到達目的地可能性的干預措施。SafeStep通過旅行圖生成實驗和涉及26個真實旅行的實地研究進行了評估。結果顯示，將Anticip8用於失敗預測與基於GPT的模型用於干預評估相結合，能夠產生最可靠的性能。用戶反饋表明，SafeStep提高了旅行過程中的信心和感知安全性，儘管界面可用性需要針對目標人群進行改進。未來，我們希望改進並發布SafeStep。為SafeStep開發的AI系統可以應用於其他領域，如心理健康、職業輔導和成癮治療。
